Supporting_Data_Values, sheet Fig5_data, 1,105 subjects. Model Y ~ C(DX) + AGE + C(SEX), OLS on untransformed abundance, Type II sums of squares.

The Results and Discussion had quoted the V1A ANCOVA as 0.647 and the V1E1 ANCOVA as 0.314. Both are Type I sums of squares; Methods specify Type II. Corrected to 0.682 and 0.405. Neither is significant under either convention.

Empirical p values in the mediation competition were computed as k / n while the original deposited mediation used (k + 1) / (n + 1). The convention is unified to (k + 1) / (n + 1) throughout, which is the value reported in the paper. Transferrin receptor moves from 0.0494 to 0.0530 and ferritin light chain from 0.0268 to 0.0301. The correction is NOT used to reverse a verdict: it was adopted after the values were known, and of the eighteen mediator-outcome tests it moves exactly one across 0.05, in the direction that favours this study's own claim. The pre-registered criterion is the position of the observed value in its own matched null, and transferrin receptor's mediated fraction of 36.2% lies above that null's 95th percentile of 35.7%. Transferrin receptor is therefore recorded as exceeding its null, as S12_VERDICTS.txt, S12_M_mediation_competition.csv and Supplemental Table 1c all record it, and rule M-1 fires on two competitors rather than one. An earlier version of this audit record said the opposite; that statement was written before the criterion was reconciled and is corrected here rather than deleted.
